page.overview:
Who is Niande Moorwyn?

Niande Moorwyn is an Aes Sedai of the Gray Ajah., Niande Moorwyn}}

She is pale-haired and plump, with a sharp nose and inquisitive gray eyes.

Niande is of low average strength for an Aes Sedai, with a One Power level of the series. She would be unable to Travel without linking with another channeler.

Niande is 149 years old, she was born in and went to the Tower in the series. After thirteen years as novice and twelve as Accepted she was raised to the shawl in the year.
